==About==

Crafting a {{i|Nutcracker Suite}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Nutcracker Suite}} which can then be baked in {{i|Any Stove}} to produce a Nutcracker Suite.

==Temporary: New Gluttony Values==
The new gluttony values below will be properly codded into the recipe (on the left and across the wiki) once player Bridget Bishop figures out how that can be done for this trickier double variable recipe that doesn't have a generic version that can be optionally boosted by using either green or red peppers.
